releasePlan.notes: Fresh multivariate flag (control + v1, dark); no prerequisite. Gate is evaluated once in init() against the anonymous context, before identify(). BUCKETING WARNING: every visitor is initialised as the hard-coded shared context key 'anonymous-player', so any percentage rollout / guarded rollout / experiment on this flag buckets ALL users identically (effectively 0% or 100%). A per-browser random anonymous key would be needed for a meaningful split — out of scope for this PR. In v1 the callsign becomes the LD context key (PII / MAU growth; identical callsigns share a key).

releaseIntent._instructions: Human approver: edit freely. action: auto (release on deploy) | hold (do not release yet) | manual (a human runs the release). Structured fields execute; anything else goes in notes (an agent will structure it on the PR for your review). Blank fields = default auto-release on deploy. prerequisites: [{"flagKey": "flag-xyz", "variation": "on"}]. notBefore: YYYY-MM-DD. reference: ticket/doc URL.
